$comment: Read by scripts/ci-audit.mjs. An exception applies only while the latest npm release of the package is still inside vulnerableRange (no patched release exists) and before the expires date. Keep this list empty whenever possible.

exceptions.reason: picomatch ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs. No patched release exists on npm (first_patched_version: null). Demos reach picomatch only through vite, vitest, and tinyglobby at build and test time, with developer-authored globs. It never ships in static bundles or in the zero-dependency gateway.
